role: XCTest suites over the cloud providers' streams and the chat layer's handling of a reply that failed partway: ProviderStreamTests checks ProviderStream.make's error mapping (URLError → .network / .cancelled, CancellationError → .cancelled, provider and unrelated errors pass through), normal event delivery, and that a consumer leaving cancels the operation; ProviderStatusFailureTests checks each provider's production non-2xx mapping (statusFailure): the 300-character body cap, OpenAI's 400 param-model case, Gemini's API_KEY_INVALID auth failure, credit exhaustion ahead of the status, and the shared auth/rate-limit/overloaded statuses; OpenAICompatibleReasoningTests checks the reasoning fields OpenAICompatibleStreamer.requestFor writes for DeepSeek (thinking disabled), OpenAI (reasoning_effort none) and Grok (neither); OpenAICompatibleEndOfStreamTests, GeminiEndOfStreamTests and AnthropicEndOfStreamTests replay in-memory SSE lines through each provider's consumeSSE (via SSEReplay) and check how a reply ends: a clean close without the terminal signal is a dropped connection, the terminal signal completes, a malformed event throws, a token-cap stop ends with '…', a safety stop is a non-fallbackable .blockedReply, a repeated finish reason adds one '…', a cut or unparseable tool call is never emitted, a mid-stream server failure is the overloaded modelUnavailable, and (Gemini, Anthropic) usage that arrived before a failure is still reported; for Anthropic, a pause_turn reply is sent back with its raw content and continued into one reply, at most maxPauseContinuations times. EndOfStreamCancellationTests checks that each reader, cancelled before its lines end cleanly, throws CancellationError rather than a dropped connection. PartialReplyTests checks ChatTurn.incomplete (old transcripts decode as complete, the mark survives storage, truncateForSend withholds it), the fallback splice (AssistantToolRunner.settle), the fact-extraction gate (AssistantTurnRouter.factExtractionExchange) and that AssistantViewModel.collect returns nothing for a failed or timed-out stream.
types: ProviderStreamTests.Unrelated: private enum Error — a non-provider error
ProviderStatusFailureTests: class — XCTestCase over the providers' statusFailure mappings
OpenAICompatibleReasoningTests: class — XCTestCase over OpenAICompatibleStreamer.requestFor body JSON
SSEReplay: enum — replays SSE lines through a provider line reader inside ProviderStream.make and records the outcome
SSEReplay.Outcome: struct — text, tool names and inputs, input and output tokens of each .usage event, whether .done arrived, and the error
EndOfStreamCancellationTests: class — XCTestCase over the three consumeSSE readers under cancellation
PartialReplyTests: @MainActor class — XCTestCase over replies that failed partway (ChatTurn.incomplete, truncateForSend, settle, factExtractionExchange, collect)
AnthropicEndOfStreamTests.PausedReplay: private struct — text, .done count and request bodies of a paused-turn replay
